about.title: About ExperienceHub
about.p1: ExperienceHub is a community knowledge base of real product ownership experiences in Bangladesh — honest reviews, the problems owners actually hit, and the fixes that worked.
about.p2: Anyone can read. Sign in to add a review, report a problem, share a solution, or ask the owners a question. Content from brand-new accounts is briefly held for review; after that it publishes straight away.
about.p3: It's built and run by one person, in the open, as an experiment. Feedback and corrections are welcome.

policy.title: Content policy
policy.p1: Write from your own experience. Reviews should reflect a product you've actually used; problems should be faults you hit yourself.
policy.p2: No spam or advertising, no fake or planted content, nothing offensive or abusive, and no personal information about other people.
policy.p3: Anyone can flag content. Moderators review flags and can hide content that breaks these rules; repeat offenders can be suspended.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.p1: Use the site lawfully and in good faith. You keep ownership of what you post, but you grant ExperienceHub the right to display and distribute it on the platform.
terms.p2: Information here is community-contributed and provided as-is — verify anything important (prices, warranty terms, specifications) with the seller or manufacturer before you rely on it.
terms.p3: Accounts that abuse the platform may be suspended or removed. These terms may change; continued use means you accept the current version.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: Signing in stores your name, email and profile photo from your sign-in provider. That's used to identify you and attribute your contributions.
privacy.p2: Your searches are logged (without linking to you personally where possible) so we can see which products people look for and can't find. Uploaded images are stored on the server that runs the site.
privacy.p3: We don't sell your data or run third-party ad tracking. You can ask for your account and its content to be deleted.

howItWorks.title: Real ownership experience, from people in Bangladesh
howItWorks.intro: ExperienceHub collects what actually happens after you buy — how products hold up, what goes wrong, and how it gets fixed — so the next buyer decides with real information.

steps.searchBody: Find the exact model you're considering. Every product page gathers ratings, reported problems, fixes and real prices in one place.
steps.readBody: See how long owners have had it, what they'd buy again, the faults people hit, and what service centres charged to fix them.
steps.contributeBody: Own something? Share a review, report a fault, post a fix that worked, or log a service-centre visit. It takes a couple of minutes.
steps.buildBody: Every contribution sharpens the ratings and problem trends other people rely on. Small notes add up to something genuinely useful.

howItWorks.trustIntro: A couple of things worth knowing before you post.

trust.moderationBody: Your first few contributions are reviewed by a moderator before they appear publicly — usually within a day. You'll find them under your dashboard while they wait.
trust.reputationBody: Helpful, genuine contributions build your reputation over time. Once you've shown you're reliable, your posts publish instantly.
